text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,291.1, up 0.58% on the day, while the broader Nifty 500 rose only 0.08%. Advances outnumbered declines (174 vs 316) giving a breadth score of 73.6, labelled “HEALTHY”. The move was fairly broad – most large‑cap indices rose, but the Bank Nifty led with a 0.89% gain, reflecting stronger banking momentum.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹4,864.68 crore, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹3,519.05 crore, extending a 13‑day FII buying streak. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 0.94 for Nifty and 1.24 for Bank Nifty, indicating slightly more call interest on Nifty and more put interest on Bank Nifty. The max‑pain levels sit at 25,200 for Nifty and 59,000 for Bank Nifty, with support walls around 25,000 (Nifty) and 57,000 (Bank Nifty) and resistance near 26,000 and 62,000 respectively.

Watch the 25,400 level for Nifty – a break could test the pivot resistance at 25,361.77 and the call wall at 26,000. For Bank Nifty, the 61,500 pivot and the 61,288.46 S1 support are key; a move above 62,000 may open the 62,000 call wall. Keep an eye on RBI’s variable‑rate reverse repo auction tomorrow and any fresh FII flow news, as they could sway short‑term direction.
